Definition: an Iezrite or descendant of Iezer
BiblicalUsage: An Iezrite is a descendant of Iezer, one of the families of Manasseh. In Numbers 26:30 the census names the family of the Jeezerites among the sons of Gilead, in the numbering of Israel in the plains of Moab.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the family name is the point: Iezer's sons are counted as a family, and the family is counted as part of Israel.
